# Luxury Society

> > Global luxury industry insights platform covering consumer trends, digital transformation, and market intelligence for brands like LVMH, Dior, Chanel, and Bulgari.

Luxury Society provides strategic analysis and thought leadership for the luxury sector, with deep expertise in the China market, UHNW consumer behavior, digital platforms like WeChat, and emerging trends across fashion, watches, beauty, and hospitality. The platform hosts Keynote events in Shanghai and other global cities to connect industry leaders.

## Key Topics

- China luxury market
- UHNW consumers and wealth management
- LVMH and Dior brand strategies
- WeChat Luxury Index
- Digital platforms and omnichannel
- Consumer behavior and customer experience
- Luxury watches e-commerce
- Cultural capital and heritage
- Shanghai luxury events
- Jean-Christophe Babin (Bulgari CEO)
- Luxury vs fast fashion
- Generation Z luxury consumers
- Re-Hub COMPASS Index
- Affiliate marketing in luxury
- Luxury hospitality expansion
